definitions.gloss: talented; versatile; gifted in many areas
definitions.explanation: Having many talents or abilities across different fields. Describes someone who excels in multiple areas rather than just one.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{多才|たさい}な{人|ひと}だ。
{多才|たさい}なアーティストとして{知|し}られている。
{彼|かれ}は{音楽|おんがく}も{絵|え}も{文章|ぶんしょう}も{上手|じょうず}で、{本当|ほんとう}に{多才|たさい}な{人物|じんぶつ}だ。
examples.english: He is good at music, art, and writing — a truly versatile person.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a な-adjective to describe people with multiple talents. Often appears in the four-character compound {多芸多才|たげいたさい} (many arts and many talents), which is more emphatic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多才|たさい}な{人|ひと} (talented person)
- {多才|たさい}な{芸術家|げいじゅつか} (versatile artist)
- {多芸多才|たげいたさい} (many arts and many talents)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多彩|たさい}: colorful, varied — homophone, but describes variety rather than talent
- {有能|ゆうのう}: capable, competent — emphasizes ability rather than breadth of talents
